slices.focus: Ariana crosses 450 verified neighborhood recordings and recognizes the archive has become genuinely durable
slices.summary: At a packed summer listening event, Ariana realizes the archive has crossed 450 verified neighborhood recordings with three-copy backup, clear permissions, and active public use. The milestone shifts her identity from rescuer to steward of a durable neighborhood archive.
open_loops: Writing a one-page note with four headings (recordings, permissions, backups, public use)
Adding a maintenance line so the milestone connects to ongoing care
Turning private durability standards into a brief written framework for the center
